formal_statement: have x1 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := [((0 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ))]; have x2 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x2 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => ∃ (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), (↑x3, ↑x4) ∈ x1 ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; ∀ (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x4 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x5 x6 : ℕ), x3.gates = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, inputs := [x5, x6] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } :: x4 → x5 < (14 : ℕ) → x6 < (14 : ℕ) → ¬((x5, x6) ∈ x1 ∨ (x6, x5) ∈ x1) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x3 → (∀ (x12 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x3.eval (List.ofFn x12) = Bool.true ↔ x2 x12) → ∃ (x13 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x13 ∧ x13.size + (1 : ℕ) ≤ x3.size ∧ ∀ (x14 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x13.eval (List.ofFn x14) = Bool.true ↔ x2 x14
plain_statement: The edge function of the Heawood graph (14 inputs, 21 edges). A circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, for it whose first gate is the AND of two inputs that are not adjacent gives a circuit of that kind, one gate smaller, for the same function.
